form.message: Project Fulcrum — dev platform planning. Small nonprofit footprint, dev only, fictional data, two-week infrastructure target and default reviews are captured. Please give rough planning choices below; Not sure / recommend is valid. Suggested ranges are not confirmed defaults, service selections or permission to spend/deploy. Application development stays with the other team. Do not enter real contacts, domains, identities or container endpoints.

workload_pattern.title: Dev hosting — workload planning pattern
workload_pattern.description: Recommendation: Development / test platform fits this hosting-only MVP. Web application with a database is an alternative planning pattern for the mobile/API workload; neither choice selects an Azure host or database. Custom answers use this same field.

daily_users.title: Dev pilot — daily test users
daily_users.description: Count fictional-user testing and platform users in this dev delivery, not future Production Volunteers. Recommendation to consider: a small pilot up to 50, if realistic. Choose a range or use a custom answer here.
enum: Not sure — start with a small pilot

peak_concurrent_users.title: Dev API — simultaneous test users
peak_concurrent_users.description: A rough peak is enough; this is concurrency, not employee count. Fewer than 10 may suit a small dev pilot, but it is not assumed. Custom answers use this same field.

monthly_budget.title: Dev Azure — monthly planning budget
monthly_budget.description: Choose a range in the currency selected below, or enter an exact amount here. Include required private networking/security in later costing; a low budget never waives the baseline. This is not spending authorization.
enum: Not decided — show me a costed recommendation

budget_currency.title: Dev estimate — budget currency
budget_currency.description: Which currency should later cost planning use? EUR is an option for EU planning, not an assumed choice. Custom answers use this same field.

budget_limit.title: Dev budget — target or hard constraint
budget_limit.description: A planning target allows alternatives with overruns highlighted. A hard limit blocks an over-budget design pending a new decision; Azure budgets alone are not automatic spend cutoffs. Neither grants spend authority. Custom answers use this same field.
enum: Planning target — optimize and highlight overruns
Hard monthly limit — do not proceed beyond it
Not sure — recommend a budgeting approach

cost_monitoring_mode.title: Dev costs — monitoring requirement
cost_monitoring_mode.description: Recommendation to consider: minimal for a dev-only pilot, keeping operational alerts. Minimal means budget-only cost monitoring; notices use Owner-role recipients and may not reach a named non-Owner. Enforced adds a cost Action Group and anomaly alert. Deferred needs a later rationale and YYYY-MM-DD expiry only after selection. Exact recipients must be securely bound later; do not enter emails here. Custom answers use this same field.
enum: minimal — budget only; operational alerts remain
enforced — budget, cost Action Group and anomaly alert
deferred — request a time-limited cost-monitoring exception

availability_target.title: Dev platform — acceptable downtime
availability_target.description: Recommendation to consider: occasional dev/test downtime acceptable, without a Production SLA claim. Higher targets may add cost. Choose the needed impact level or a custom answer here.
enum: Business hours — recover within the working day
Not sure — recommend a suitable target

recovery_profile.title: Dev platform — interruption and test-data loss
recovery_profile.description: Recommendation to consider: relaxed recovery for fictional dev data. These are planning objectives, not tested capabilities. No Production recovery commitment is included. Custom answers use this same field.
enum: Relaxed — recover within a day; up to half a day of data loss
Standard — recover within 4 hours; up to 1 hour of data loss
Critical — recover within 15 minutes; up to 5 minutes of data loss

performance_target.title: Dev API host — response-time planning intent
performance_target.description: Capture platform planning intent only; application optimization/tests remain with the other team. Recommendation to consider: usable smoke tests without a fixed latency target for this first dev platform. Custom numeric targets or Not sure can be entered here.
enum: Usable dev smoke tests — no fixed latency target
Typical API responses under 2 seconds — planning goal to validate
Not sure — recommend a practical dev target

iac_tool.title: Platform delivery — IaC tool preference
iac_tool.description: Bicep is Azure-native; Terraform suits existing Terraform skills or multi-cloud work. Recommendation to consider: Bicep if there is no existing tool preference. This is not IaC generation authorization. Custom answers use this same field.

target_region.title: Dev hosting — region preference
target_region.description: Sweden Central is an unconfirmed repository fallback only. Select a preference or let Architecture recommend an allowed region; this does not confirm service availability or authorize Azure access. Residency is not inferred from choosing a region. Custom answers use this same field.
enum: No preference — recommend an allowed region

private_client_access.title: Private dev services — caller access intent
private_client_access.description: Private data access, API isolation and private DNS remain mandatory even with fictional data. Capture the access need, not a VPN/topology decision; a new path must fit effective policy. Recommendation if unknown: let Architecture design a secure path. No endpoint, principal or real domain is needed. Custom answers use this same field.
enum: A new secure remote-access path is needed
Only applications need access; no direct human data access
Not sure — design a suitable secure path

authentication_requirement.title: Dev identity platform — sign-in population
authentication_requirement.description: Which sign-in capability should the platform support for fictional dev testing? External Volunteer sign-in is not automatically employee Entra sign-in; greenfield external identity uses Entra External ID where applicable. Exact registrations/roles and application implementation stay with the other team. No real identities are requested. Custom answers use this same field.
enum: Employees plus external Volunteers — fictional dev accounts

answers.industry: Nonprofit community support for vulnerable individuals and families; volunteer-led experiences and support
answers.current_delivery_scope: New dev-only hosting-platform MVP; first usable infrastructure within two weeks. Future Production is outside this delivery.
answers.current_delivery_data_constraint: Development uses fictional data only. Mandatory security/privacy baseline applies in dev; future Production GDPR requirement remains outside this dev delivery, with no compliance certification.
answers.system_description: Infrastructure-only hosting platform and cloud services for a secure, intuitive, mobile-first Volunteer engagement MVP, including support for a containerized backend. All application development is handled by another team and is out of scope.
answers.business_objective: Reduce manual coordination and administrative overhead; improve Volunteer engagement and matching, opportunity discovery, assignments, approvals, tracking, reporting, visibility and communication; accelerate assignments and grow without proportional administration.
answers.delivery_context: New MVP; pro bono initiative for The Organization. Existing coordination relies on calls, email, instant messaging, spreadsheets and manual approvals/follow-ups, causing overhead, low visibility and poor scalability. This is business context, not a migration request.
infrastructure_scope: Hosting support for a containerized backend; backend code excluded
Notification platform capabilities, with channels still to evaluate
Store anonymous resulting documentation in this repository
application_scope_exclusions: Detailed business workflow, escalation and reporting implementation
answers.application_role_constraints: Initial permission boundaries require Project Stakeholders validation. Manager is a functional role, not an identifiable party. Exact permissions and application implementation belong to another team.
answers.configurable_workflow_intent: Volunteer registration, participation approval, assignment confirmation, cancellations and changes. Exact rules and escalation remain undefined, belong to the application team, and do not block platform intake.
answers.operational_reporting_intent: Opportunities, registrations, assignment status, completed activities and participation. Detailed reports and impact metrics require application stakeholder confirmation.
answers.technology_evaluation_constraints: Candidates are not mandatory selections. Evaluate alternatives for suitability, security, simplicity, maintainability, scale and cost within limited nonprofit budgets; challenge complexity and avoid overengineering.
answers.design_preferences_not_decisions: Prefer managed services and a modular monolith; no microservices absent clear justification.
answers.data_processing_constraints: Personal Volunteer information and sensitive organizational activity may be processed. Beneficiary data is not assumed. Never use real personal information in development or testing; fictional sample data only.
security_privacy_requirements: Secure authentication and role-based access control
Encryption in transit and at rest
compliance: GDPR required for Production. MVP must be GDPR-aligned; the supplied brief says MVP does not have to be compliant. This release distinction does not waive applicable legal duties or mandatory security/privacy controls. Do not certify compliance.
anonymity_requirements: Anonymous generated source, documentation, commits, issues, pull requests, test data, infrastructure-as-code and artifacts
No customer/nonprofit or technology-partner names, individual names, real domains, organizational identifiers, correspondence or real beneficiary/Volunteer information
Use only generic party labels: The Organization, Technology Contributors, Volunteers, Coordinators, Administrators, Project Stakeholders
Do not request real names, personal emails, domains or identities during discovery
Do not publish repository remote URLs or account identities in project documentation
Author attribution uses agent role only; no people
answers.recommendation_provenance_requirement: Reasonable recommendations must be labelled Assumption/Recommendation, never represented as user-confirmed values or permission.
answers.sku_pin_evidence: No SKU locks were volunteered. This is not an explicit no-preference response and does not complete SKU elicitation.
answers.authorized_current_activity: Bounded Step 1 requirements discovery, anonymous documentation, validation and the required independent review through the interactive parent. No Azure reads or writes, credential operations, deployment, infrastructure code, application scaffolding, commits or pushes are authorized.
